radhakrishnan.oneLineEn: Restated Indian thought via modern Vedanta and comparative philosophy, placing religious experience in world dialogue.

madhva.oneLineEn: Opposed Advaita with Dvaita Vedanta, stressing real difference among God, soul, and world.

charles-taylor.oneLineEn: Remade political philosophy, ethics, and religious modernity studies via modern self, recognition, and secularization.

bentham.oneLineEn: Linked ethics, legislation, and political calculation through greatest happiness and institutional legal reform.

comte.oneLineEn: Joined modern knowledge order to social reorganization via three stages, science classification, and sociology.

schleiermacher.oneLineEn: Linked modern theology, interpretation theory, and individuality via religious feeling and universal hermeneutics.

reid.oneLineEn: Answered skepticism with common-sense principles and direct realism, extending epistemology to action and freedom.

tocqueville.oneLineEn: Analyzed fragile conditions of modern free societies through democratic equality, association, and anti-centralization.

gramsci.oneLineEn: Rewrote Marxist revolutionary strategy and cultural politics via hegemony, civil society, and organic intellectuals.

lukacs.oneLineEn: Laid key prehistory for Western Marxism and critical theory via reification, totality, and class consciousness.

bloch.oneLineEn: Joined Marxist emancipatory politics, religious symbols, and utopia via Principle of Hope and not-yet consciousness.

marcuse.oneLineEn: Advanced Frankfurt School politics via technological rationality, desire liberation, and industrial-society critique.

fromm.oneLineEn: Explained modern freedom, character, and social pathology via humanistic psychoanalysis and Marxist alienation theory.

berlin.oneLineEn: Remade 20th-c. liberal anti-utopian argument through two concepts of liberty and value pluralism.

hayek.oneLineEn: Critiqued planning rationality and rebuilt liberal rule-of-law theory via dispersed knowledge and spontaneous order.

schmitt.oneLineEn: Exposes modern political crisis via sovereignty, exception, and friend-enemy; read critically amid Nazi complicity.

croce.oneLineEn: Recast Italian idealism through expression aesthetics, historicism, and liberal history of freedom, reviving Vico.

yan-hui.oneLineEn: Yan Yuan, Confucius's disciple famed for virtue, later taken as a classic model of Confucian self-cultivation.
keywordsEn: contentment in poverty with the Way

zengzi.oneLineEn: Later Confucian disciple known for transmitting filial piety, vigilant solitude, and self-cultivation.

zisi.oneLineEn: Confucius's grandson and a key early Warring States link in the transmission from Confucius to Mencius.
